import pandas as pd
from datetime import date, timedelta

pd.set_option("display.width", 230); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth", 88)

TODAY = date(2026,10,12)
LIMIT, DEDUCTIBLE, COINS_PCT, ACV_BASIS = 500_000.0, 5_000.0, None, False

# ============ HYPOTHETICAL INPUTS (clearly illustrative, NOT a claim) =====
HYP = dict(
    building_rcv        = 180_000.0,  # flooring/drywall RCV  - ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY
    building_deprec     = 40_000.0,   # recoverable depreciation
    bpp_stock_rcv       = 25_000.0,   # inventory/BPP
    bpp_deprec          =  5_000.0,
    mold_sub_rcv        = 12_000.0,   # if a mold sublimit applies
    mold_sub_limit      = 15_000.0,
    bi_loss             = 0.0,        # none claimed at present
    coinsurance_applied = False,      # coinsurance %
)

# ============ 1. REMITTANCE WATERFALL =====================================
# Step order per standard commercial property practice:
#  (a) establish covered RCV per item
#  (b) apply any sub-limit BEFORE loss-wide deductible
#  (c) sum covered loss
#  (d) apply coinsurance factor if applicable
#  (e) apply policy limit
#  (f) apply single per-occurrence deductible
#  (g) first payment on ACV basis; recoverable depreciation on completion
def waterfall(h):
    steps = []
    # (a)/(b) covered amount with sublimit
    mold_covered = min(h["mold_sub_rcv"], h["mold_sub_limit"])
    gross_covered = h["building_rcv"] + h["bpp_stock_rcv"] + mold_covered + h["bi_loss"]
    steps.append(("1. Covered loss at RCV (post sub-limit)", gross_covered,
                  f"Building {h['building_rcv']:,.0f} + BPP {h['bpp_stock_rcv']:,.0f} "
                  f"+ moldsub {mold_covered:,.0f} (capped at {h['mold_sub_limit']:,.0f}) "
                  f"+ BI {h['bi_loss']:,.0f}"))
    # (d) coinsurance
    if h["coinsurance_applied"] and COINS_PCT:
        after_coins = gross_covered * COINS_PCT
        steps.append(("2. Coinsurance factor applied", after_coins, f"x {COINS_PCT:.2f}"))
    else:
        after_coins = gross_covered
        steps.append(("2. Coinsurance factor", after_coins, "N/A - no coinsurance penalty / not applied"))
    # (e) limit
    after_limit = min(after_coins, LIMIT)
    steps.append(("3. Policy limit applied", after_limit, f"min(loss, limit {LIMIT:,.0f})"))
    # (f) deductible
    net_owed = max(after_limit - DEDUCTIBLE, 0.0)
    steps.append(("4. Less deductible", net_owed, f"- {DEDUCTIBLE:,.0f} (per occurrence)"))
    # (g) ACV split
    recoverable_deprec = h["building_deprec"] + h["bpp_deprec"]
    acv_payment = max(net_owed - recoverable_deprec, 0.0)
    steps.append(("5. Initial (ACV) payment", acv_payment,
                  f"net owed {net_owed:,.0f} - recoverable depreciation {recoverable_deprec:,.0f}"))
    steps.append(("6. Held-back recoverable depreciation", recoverable_deprec,
                  "payable only on proof of repair/replacement after loss"))
    steps.append(("7. Recoverable depreciation - trigger", recoverable_deprec,
                  "released on completion of repairs, within policy time limit"))
    return steps, dict(gross_covered=gross_covered, net_owed=net_owed,
                       acv_payment=acv_payment, recoverable=recoverable_deprec)

steps, tot = waterfall(HYP)
wf = pd.DataFrame(steps, columns=["Step","Amount ($)","Note"])
pd.options.display.float_format = "{:,.2f}".format

# ============ 2. PAYEE / ISSUANCE MECHANICS ==============================
payee = pd.DataFrame([
 ("Named insured","Harborview Retail LLC","First party - primary payee"),
 ("Mortgagee / loss payee (building)","[LENDER TO CONFIRM]","Building loss drafts are typically issued jointly per the mortgage clause"),
 ("Loss payee (contents/BPP)","[TO CONFIRM]","Only if a secured interest exists in contents - often none"),
 ("Public adjuster fee (if any)","[NONE ON FILE]","Never paid from the carrier draft; PA billed separately by agreement"),
 ("Deductible","Retained by insured","Not remitted - deducted before issuance"),
], columns=["Party","Status","Treatment"])

# ============ 3. SUBROGATION WORKFLOW + NET RECOVERY MATH ================
subro = pd.DataFrame([
 ("1","Preserve evidence & artifacts","Immediately","Failed pipe section/fitting retained unaltered; photos of the failure point; do not discard during repairs.","Preservation letter to insured/restoration vendor"),
 ("2","Cause & origin determination","<30 days","Establish whether a third party caused or contributed to the failure.","Engineer/plumber report"),
 ("3","Subrogation screen memo","<45 days","Decide pursue/decline with written rationale; document SOL expiry.","Sol clock = 3 yrs from DOL (RCW 4.16.080(2))"),
 ("4","Confirm SOL & any contractual limitation","<45 days","Diary the earliest expiry; tolling agreement if near the bar.","Tolling agreement"),
 ("5","Notice/preservation letters to targets","<60 days","Preserve carrier's rights; put potential targets on notice.","Letter to contractor/manufacturer as applicable"),
 ("6","Obtain contracts, warranties, invoices, licenses","<60 days","Identify the party bound and the applicable duty.","EV-29/31/40"),
 ("7","Demand / negotiation","as pursued","Subrogation demand with supporting quantum.","Demand package"),
 ("8","File suit if unresolved","before SOL","File in Washington superior court or agreed forum.","Complaint + expert report"),
 ("9","Recover & apply","on receipt","Reimburse claim file net of costs; account to insured for any deductible/recoverable deprec.","Recovery receipt"),
], columns=["#","Step","Timing","Action","Instrument"])

def net_recovery(gross_recovery, allocable_costs, deductible=5_000.0):
    net = gross_recovery - allocable_costs
    # Subrogation allocation: carrier recovers what it paid; insured recovers its deductible
    # and any unreimbursed items, on a "made whole" analysis under WA law.
    return net
gross_rec, costs = 120_000.0, 18_000.0
net_rec = net_recovery(gross_rec, costs)

rec = pd.DataFrame([
 ("Gross subrogation recovery","$120,000.00","ILLUSTRATIVE - no recovery asserted"),
 ("Less allocable costs (experts, attorney, collection)","$18,000.00","Typically pro-rata to carrier first"),
 ("Net recovery to carrier","$102,000.00","Reimburses amounts the carrier actually paid"),
 ("Insured's deductible (Uninsured/under-recovered)","$5,000.00","Accounted to insured on a made-whole basis (WA law)"),
 ("Made-whole caveat","Applies","Undersigned may need to be made whole before carrier shares in recovery - WA law"),
], columns=["Item","Amount","Note"])

print("="*130); print("REMITTANCE & RECOVERY PROCESS - CP-2024-1187 (PROCEDURAL WALKTHROUGH; NO PAYMENT EXECUTED)"); print("="*130)
print("\nNOTE: All figures below are HYPOTHETICAL for arithmetic illustration only. No claim amount has been established.")
print("\n--- 1. REMITTANCE CALCULATION WATERFALL (hypothetical inputs) ---")
print(wf.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\n  Net owed (post-deductible): ${tot['net_owed']:,.2f}")
print(f"  Initial ACV payment:        ${tot['acv_payment']:,.2f}")
print(f"  Recoverable depreciation:   ${tot['recoverable']:,.2f} (held, released on completion)")
print("\n--- 2. PAYEE / ISSUANCE MECHANICS ---")
print(payee.to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- 3. SUBROGATION WORKFLOW ---")
print(subro.to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- 4. ILLUSTRATIVE NET-RECOVERY MATH ---")
print(rec.to_string(index=False))
